The '''Krantian Language''' was the language spoken on [[Krant]], a colony world in the [[Krant system/Legends|Krant system]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] once translated a [[Krantian/Legends|Krantian]] leader's speech into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] for [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].
